title: Incident COP Data Model
description: Open SAR-COP incident data contract. An AI (or human) assembles one incident.json per disaster following this schema; the builder then renders it into a COP dashboard. Primary fields are in ENGLISH (default display language); every text field may carry a *_zh variant (e.g. title_zh, summary_zh) for Simplified Chinese. The dashboard falls back to the primary field when a *_zh field is absent.

slug.description: Unique incident id, also the repo name: <country-code>-<region>-<hazard-type>-<year>, e.g. np-rasuwa-landslide-2026

title.description: Incident full name in English (primary). 中文标题：尼泊尔热索瓦特大泥石流灾害

title_zh.description: Optional Simplified Chinese title (中文标题)

event_type.description: Hazard type: landslide / debris flow / earthquake / typhoon / flood / avalanche / ...

event_type_zh.description: Optional Chinese hazard type (灾害类型，中文)

onset.description: Onset time, ISO 8601 with timezone where possible

status.description: active=response ongoing; monitoring=monitoring residual risks; closed=closed

summary_zh.description: Optional Chinese overview (事件概述，中文)

label.description: e.g. Confirmed deaths / Missing / Bridges damaged

note.description: Timeliness & attribution, e.g. as of Aug 27 evening, per Nepal Police

note_zh.description: Optional Chinese note (截至时间与口径)

casualty_series.description: Casualty figures over time (for the trend chart)

name.description: Site name in English (romanized where applicable)

category.description: incident=hazard site; damage=damaged infrastructure; community=affected settlement; command=command/coordination; resource=response asset; risk=risk zone

description.description: English description; MUST state 'approximate location' if geocoded

corridor.description: Optional linear feature: risk corridor / river / road

note.description: English note; must state 'schematic trace, not exact'

type.description: military / police / fire / medical / volunteer / international coordination ...

tag_zh.description: Optional Chinese tag (灾情/响应/预报/国际)

sources.description: Data sources. REQUIRED, must not be empty.

name.description: Source name in English (add original-language name in parentheses if useful)
